title: 204章 木源城中心思转203章 长春功的三重变
lines: 不仅仅是法力的弥补，伴随着这突如其来的法力精元，张荼发现自己的身体也是开始发生着变化。内视可以发现，自己的五脏六腑似是也得到了滋养，闪烁着淡淡的光辉。而自己骨骼的密度，也越来越大；自己的肌肤除了肤色没有变化之外，竟是变得愈加的滑嫩，甚至闪烁着晶莹的光泽。
体质的不断提升，所带来的可不仅仅只是恢复那般简单，如今体质还能够提升，那只能说是在发生质的变化，超越了以往多多，使得体质更上一层楼。
此时此刻，张荼感觉自己的每一寸肌肤都充满了爆炸性的力量，感觉自己可以跟妖修厮杀之时，不动用相思，都可以进行一场硬碰硬的对决。
当张荼幽幽醒转之时，发现战场之上的熊熊烈火早已经熄灭，而且原本的参天巨木也在炮火和法力的夹击之下，变得空荡荡的，恍若一片饱受蹂躏的平原。不用升空张荼也知道，此刻的木源城外，那恍若碧玉的毯子，又被人烫了几个丑陋的烟洞。
扭头看见子矜和裹成木乃伊一般的秦风站在自己身后的不远处，默默地守护着，在更远处，可以看到徐林带着一些伤痕累累的b级修士在警戒着。
笑了笑，随后抬头仰望无尽虚无的天空，默默地沉思着。今日的木源城因为自己等人的缘故，有惊无险地守住了，但是其他城池呢？张荼不知道，但是他知道仅凭借自己一个人，是无力守护整个九州。
英雄，亦是需要联盟。
不过，这并不是让他气馁的理由，路都是一步步走出来的。毕竟弱小是必经的过程，而且对于长春功的明悟以及串联起来轮回海，张荼发现了一个自己忽略的事情。
异域征伐，是真实存在的么？
若是真实存在，自己等人无异于是轮回一场，可是若不是真实存在，谢夕岚等人的真实经验又是从何而来。若是有人可以逆转时空，将自己等人毫无知觉地彻底打回孩提时代，同时封印了所有的记忆，在特定的情况之下才可打开。
这种手段，多少有些匪夷所思，怕是天道也做不到，因为这种手段已经违背了天道的基本规则，除非进行一场大破灭，万物灭绝的混乱时期，才可以如此的为所欲为，但是如今的九州明显是未曾经历这种浩劫。
别说普通人了，就是强如一品，也绝无可能在世界的大破灭之中生存。毕竟，如今超过一品的手段势必会刺激到沉睡的天道，所以一切就好似进入了一个无解的循环之中，或许边关月可以给自己一个解释。
如今的木源城中，多少有些冷清和死寂，毕竟中青一代的不少人都已经永远的埋骨在了城外的战场之上。如今的妖祸，对于无数拥有了新的力量的中青年来说，或许中年男人心中武侠梦的侠义精神，又或者是青年心中保家卫国的热血精神。
也可能更多人是在变强，是在追梦，追逐理想，或许有些以偏概全，但是有不少人却是如此，就这么一去不回地倒在了木源城外。
入城的过程中，张荼看到一个个热切的脸庞，有酒楼中吃最后一顿酒的熟悉人影，也有那夜篝火晚会中的热血少年，可是他们每一个人的脸上，都带着悲痛和不甘，又夹杂着击退妖祸的开心喜悦。
每个人的脸庞上的表情，都复杂得很。
这时候，子矜突然低低说了一句，道：“啊荼，那天篝火晚会，那个毒蛇的中年人还记得么？”
张荼有些不解，但是依旧缓缓点头，表示记得。
“我在城头看着真切，那个毒舌的中年人，为了救下来那个不断跟他对呛的那个少年，被一头b级妖兽活活生撕了。”子矜的声音低沉到了极致，甚至带着淡淡的哭腔，虽然她那一日也不喜欢那个邋遢的中年人，可是当看到他毫不犹豫地为了一群少年而奉献自己生命的时候，她只想质问自己，为什么自己不是在那个战场之上，与他们一同并肩！
随着子矜的话语，张荼亦是想起了那个言语颇为偏激的邋遢中年人，但是他的举动，却是在意料之中，情理之外。虽然那人言语中比较偏激，但是张荼却是没有在他的声音中听到丝毫的戾气，却尽是市井小民的烟火气。
就像是盘算着自己家的地被人偷了几颗菜，或者说是丢了几个瓜，虽然嘴上不饶人，却是没有丝毫追究的意思，明明心中善良得不行，可是嘴上却偏偏不饶人。
在话语之中，张荼同样的听到了不解和一丝丝的怨怼。可是自己怎么会允许她出现在那般混乱的战场之上呢？虽然她拥有着b级的修为，可是在张荼的眼中依旧是需要被保护且手无缚鸡之力的女子。
“你上战场，会乱了我的节奏，我会分心。”张荼犹豫了片刻之后，还是缓缓地解释道：“所以，你不上战场，就是对我最好的帮助。当我知道你安全的时候，我便可以放手厮杀，至少我知道在我无力再战之时，有人可以保护我，让我没有后顾之忧。”
子矜听到张荼的话语，神色凝重地看着他，声音微微有些发颤：“这是你的心里话么？你真的是这么打算的？不觉得我是一个拖油瓶？”
“你以为？秦风如今更多需要跟我一起冲杀，不然真的就浪费了他的传承，但是你知道，匹夫无罪怀璧其罪，我如今便是如此。”张荼的声音很低，但是子矜听得很真切。“我们不能去期盼所有人都是善良的，人心似水，易反复。所以我在为更多值得我去守护的人厮杀的时候，我不能把自己的安危交付他人之手。”
似是放心不下来，张荼继续低声絮絮叨叨地说道：“而且你日后可以尝试着隐藏一下你的修为进境，作为暗子我觉得比较好，密录里面应该有相关的，你可以好好看看，若是没有，我让边关月给找一些。毕竟如今琅琊城的其他人，实力都摆在了明面上，虽然看着很爽很强大，但是也容易被人针对。”
跟子矜说的话，其实正是张荼心中的担忧，除去了第一批自己参与的强者以外，其他人更是不可能掩藏，以边关月的老谋深算，他势必会让所有人铆足了劲向上爬，但是木秀于林风必摧之，一向内敛惯了的张荼，不喜欢打明牌。
一时间子矜有些失神，一直把自己定位为拖油瓶的她，所以才一心想要去在张荼的面前证明自己，所以才会在镇江城外义无反顾地踏上了湛蓝擂台。她只是要证明自己，不是一个拖油瓶，不是一个花瓶，更不是一个一无是处的废物。
可是如今，她却是猛然发现，在张荼的面前，她从来都不需要去证明自己，因为张荼早就已经把自己当作了他最后一张底牌。
哪怕是这张牌打出去的机会十分的渺茫。一时间，子矜的内心十分的矛盾，她想要证明自己，但是又不想张荼真的进入了山穷水尽的地步，那个时候，她不知道自己究竟有没有能力拯救所有人。
随后，她便是已经释然，既然张荼可以如此的相信自己，那么自己还需要证明给谁看呢？只要张荼心里清楚，自己安心地做一个花瓶和拖油瓶又有什么了不起的呢？
看到陷入沉思的子矜，张荼缓缓地长出了一口气，但是旋即回过神来，却是发现，自己的这个想法貌似真的可行，谁会怀疑一个柔柔弱弱的姑娘，拥有着不逊于一流强者的修为和实力呢？
虽说如今的子矜还要差上一筹，但那是因为起步晚了许多，而且加上自己和琅琊城，日后未必没有追赶上他们的机会，如此一来，也好。
张荼随着人流不断地前进，待到了自己的等人落脚旬月的小院之时，目中却是露出了一丝留恋，因为他知道，木源城妖祸结束，待到秦风伤势好转，便是自己等人离去的时候，如今三次妖祸已经度过，自己是时候回转琅琊城了。
家里的人么，你们还好么？
只是不知道这一次回去，是不是有很多熟悉的面孔再也见不到了，这也是张荼甚少与琅琊城联系的原因之一，与其现在零星的悲痛，不如回去之后，一起伤心吧。毕竟之前就算是知道，自己也回不去，也不能回去。
想到这里，张荼的面上忍不住浮现一抹悲伤之色，而且心中还有着一丝担忧，因为他知道，自己还有三个地方没有去。
影少和浩爷无须担忧，自己抵达之时，便是举家搬迁之日，这是已经达成默契的时候。
唯有，那个人，让他心中担忧不已。
在张荼的心中，甚至忍不住有一种最坏的打算，这一次就算去了，也并不想见到这个人。就当她在妖祸之中失踪好了。但是若是她不存在了，那么有太多的事情无法解释，例如暗琼的存在。
但是她若是存在，那么异域的事情，又该怎么解释呢。
难道，当初异域之行，便是已经有着另外一股势力在暗中操控么？妖族，没有这个实力，不过是自命不凡的棋子罢了，这点，张荼心中很是清楚。
“谢夕岚，我该如何是好？”
content_en:
Not only was the mana making up for it, but with this sudden mana essence, Zhang Tu found that his body was also beginning to change. Looking inside, you can find that your internal organs seem to have been nourished and are shining with a faint brilliance. The density of his bones is also getting larger and larger; apart from the fact that his skin color remains unchanged, his skin has become smoother and smoother, even shining with a crystal luster.
The continuous improvement of physical fitness brings more than just recovery. Now that physical fitness can be improved, it can only be said that a qualitative change is taking place, surpassing many in the past, making physical fitness even better.
At this moment, Zhang Tu felt that every inch of his skin was full of explosive power. He felt that when he fought with the demon cultivator, he could have a head-to-head duel without using Xiangsi.
When Zhang Tu faintly woke up, he found that the raging fire on the battlefield had long been extinguished, and the original towering trees had become empty under the attack of artillery fire and magic power, as if they were a ravaged plain. Zhang Tu didn't need to go up to the sky to know that at this moment, outside Muyuan City, the jade-like blanket had several ugly smoke holes burned into it.
Turning his head, he saw Zijin and Qin Feng, who were wrapped like mummies, standing not far behind him, guarding silently. Farther away, Xu Lin could be seen guarding with some scarred B-level monks.
笑了笑，随后抬头仰望无尽虚无的天空，默默地沉思着。 Muyuan City today was defended without any danger because of himself and others, but what about the other cities? Zhang Tu didn't know, but he knew that he alone was unable to protect the entire Kyushu.
Heroes also need alliances.
However, this is no reason to be discouraged. The road is taken step by step.毕竟弱小是必经的过程，而且对于长春功的明悟以及串联起来轮回海，张荼发现了一个自己忽略的事情。
Do conquests in foreign lands really exist?
若是真实存在，自己等人无异于是轮回一场，可是若不是真实存在，谢夕岚等人的真实经验又是从何而来。 If someone could reverse time and space, completely knocking himself and others back to their childhood without any consciousness, and at the same time seal all memories, which can only be opened under certain circumstances.
This method is somewhat unimaginable, and I am afraid that even the law of heaven cannot do it, because this method has violated the basic rules of the law of heaven. Unless there is a great destruction and a chaotic period of extinction of all things, you can do whatever you want, but today's Kyushu has obviously never experienced such a catastrophe.
别说普通人了，就是强如一品，也绝无可能在世界的大破灭之中生存。 After all, today's methods that exceed the first level are bound to stimulate the sleeping Heavenly Dao, so everything seems to have entered an unsolvable cycle. Perhaps Bian Guanyue can give herself an explanation.
Today's Muyuan City is somewhat deserted and silent. After all, many people of the middle and young generation have been buried on the battlefield outside the city forever. Today's evil disaster, for countless young and middle-aged people who have new powers, may be the chivalrous spirit of the martial arts dream in the hearts of middle-aged men, or the passionate spirit of protecting the home and country in the hearts of young people.
It may be that more people are getting stronger, chasing dreams, and pursuing ideals. This may be a bit overgeneralized, but many people are like this and just fall outside Muyuan City without ever returning.
During the process of entering the city, Zhang Tu saw eager faces, including familiar figures having their last meal in the restaurant, and passionate young people at the bonfire party that night. However, on each of their faces, there was grief and unwillingness, mixed with the joy of repelling the monster.
The expressions on everyone's face are very complicated.
At this time, Zijin suddenly said in a low voice, "Ah Tu, do you still remember that poisonous middle-aged man at the bonfire party that day?"
张荼有些不解，但是依旧缓缓点头，表示记得。
"I saw it clearly at the top of the city. The middle-aged man with a vicious tongue was torn alive by a B-level monster in order to save the young man who kept choking with him." Zijin's voice was extremely low, even with a hint of crying, although She didn't like that sloppy middle-aged man that day, but when she saw him sacrificing his life for a group of teenagers without hesitation, she just wanted to ask herself why she wasn't on that battlefield, side by side with them!
Following Zi Jin's words, Zhang Tu also thought of that sloppy middle-aged man who spoke rather extreme words, but his actions were expected and unreasonable. Although the man's words were extreme, Zhang Tu didn't hear the slightest hint of hostility in his voice, but it was full of the smoke and mirrors of a common man.
It's like calculating how many vegetables have been stolen from your own land, or how many melons have been thrown away. Although you say you are not forgiving, you have no intention of pursuing it. You are obviously very kind in your heart, but your words are unforgiving.
在话语之中，张荼同样的听到了不解和一丝丝的怨怼。 But how could he allow her to appear on such a chaotic battlefield? Although she has B-level cultivation, in Zhang Tu's eyes she is still a woman who needs to be protected and has no power to restrain a chicken.
"If you go to the battlefield, it will mess up my rhythm and distract me." After Zhang Tu hesitated for a moment, he slowly explained: "So, if you don't go to the battlefield, it is the best help to me. When I know that you are safe, I can let go and fight. At least I know that when I am unable to fight anymore, someone can protect me so that I have no worries."
Zijin heard Zhang Tu's words and looked at him solemnly, her voice trembling slightly: "Is this what you are saying? Is this really what you plan to do? Don't you think I am a sluggish person?"
"What do you think? Qin Feng now needs to fight more with me, otherwise his inheritance will really be wasted, but you know, every man is not guilty of carrying a treasure, and that is what I am now." Zhang Tu's voice was very low, but Zijin heard it very clearly. "We can't expect everyone to be kind. People's hearts are like water and easy to change. So when I am fighting for more people who are worthy of my protection, I cannot leave my own safety in the hands of others."
Seemingly uneasy, Zhang Tu continued to murmur in a low voice: "And you can try to hide your cultivation level in the future. As a secret agent, I think it is better. There should be relevant information in the secret records. You can take a good look. If not, I will ask Bian Guanyue to find some. After all, the strength of other people in Langya City is on the bright side now. Although it looks cool and powerful, it is also easy to be targeted."
What he said to Zi Jin was actually Zhang Tu's worry. Except for the first batch of strong men who participated, it was impossible for others to hide it. With Bian Guanyue's cunning and formidable calculations, he would definitely make everyone work hard to climb up. However, the trees in the forest would be destroyed by the wind, and Zhang Tu, who was always reserved, did not like to play his cards right.
Zi Jin was a little distracted for a while. She had always positioned herself as a dragster, so she wanted to prove herself in front of Zhang Tu, so she stepped onto the blue arena outside Zhenjiang City without hesitation. She just wants to prove that she is not a dragster, not a vase, and not a good-for-nothing waste.
But now, she suddenly discovered that she never had to prove herself in front of Zhang Tu, because Zhang Tu had already regarded herself as his last trump card.
Even the chance of playing this card is very slim. For a moment, Zijin was very conflicted. She wanted to prove herself, but she didn't want Zhang Tu to really reach the end of her rope. At that time, she didn't know whether she had the ability to save everyone.
Afterwards, she felt relieved. Since Zhang Tu could believe in herself so much, who else did she need to prove to? As long as Zhang Tu knows it in his heart, what's the big deal in making a vase and an oil bottle by himself?
Seeing Zi Jin who was deep in thought, Zhang Tu let out a slow breath, but when he came back to his senses, he found that his idea seemed feasible. Who would doubt that a weak and weak girl had cultivation and strength that was not inferior to that of a first-class strong man?
Although Zijin is still a little behind now, that's because he started much later, and together with himself and Langya City, there may not be any chance of catching up with them in the future. This way, it's good.
Zhang Tu continued to move forward with the flow of people. When he and others settled in the small courtyard of Xunyue, there was a trace of nostalgia in his eyes, because he knew that the demon disaster in Muyuan City was over, and when Qin Feng's injury improved, it would be time for him and others to leave. Now that the three demon disasters have been over, it was time for him to return to Langya City.
Everyone at home, are you okay?
I just don’t know if many familiar faces will never be seen again when I go back this time. This is one of the reasons why Zhang Tu has little contact with Langya City. Instead of feeling sporadic grief now, it is better to be sad together after going back. After all, even if he knew it before, he couldn't go back, and he couldn't go back.
Thinking of this, Zhang Tu couldn't help but have a look of sadness on his face, and there was also a trace of worry in his heart, because he knew that he still had three places to go.
There is no need for Young Master Ying and Master Hao to worry. When they arrive, it will be the day for their family to move. This is when they have reached a tacit understanding.
Only that person made him worried.
In Zhang Tu's heart, he couldn't help but have the worst plan. Even if he went this time, he didn't want to see this person. Just pretend that she disappeared in the evil disaster. But if she no longer exists, then there are too many things that cannot be explained, such as the existence of An Qiong.
But if she exists, how can we explain the foreign affairs.
Could it be that another force was secretly controlling the trip to a foreign land? The demon clan, without this strength, is just a pretentious chess piece. Zhang Tu knows this very well.
"Xie Xilan, what should I do?"
